raw_text:
Dattatreya S Vellal
Email: davellal@in.ibm.com | Mobile: +91-99723-12693

=== SUMMARY / ROLES ===

March 2011 – Present (Staff Software Engineer): Developer for Natural Resources Center of Excellence. Writes middleware services in Java for the condition monitoring solution at Industry Solutions, India Software Labs, IBM India Pvt. Ltd.

December 2010 – March 2011 (Software Engineer): Lead and Worldwide contact for Lotus Expeditor Webcontainer. Identified for technical and leadership skills; worldwide contact and lead of Lotus Expeditor Webcontainer and Portlet container.

October 2008 – December 2010 (Associate Software Engineer): Developer and component owner for Lotus Expeditor Toolkit. Responsible for successful delivery of Lotus Expeditor Toolkit v6.2.1, v6.2.2, and leading activities for v6.2.3.

July 2007 – September 2008 (Associate Software Engineer): Developer for JAX-WS layer enablement on Lotus Expeditor and Light Weight Infrastructure.

=== SKILLS ===
Languages: Java
Web: J2EE, Web Services, SOAP, XML
Databases: DB2
Tools/Products: RAD, RSA, WID, Eclipse, IID, SOAPUI, Lotus Expeditor & Toolkit, Lotus Notes, Lotus Sametime, IBM Smart Cloud for Social Business, WPS, WAS

=== PROJECTS ===

Natural Resource Center of Excellence – Advanced Condition Monitoring for High Value Assets (March 2011 – Present)
Roles: Developer – Integration Services, User Interface Development Lead, Source Code Administrator, RTC/Community Maintainer, VM owner/maintainer, Scrum Master, Collaterals owner/creator.
Key contributions:
- Responsible for middleware services components; writes integration services and information management services
- Owns India Software Labs Natural Resources CoE community
- Creator/owner of team area managing tasks, stories, epics for agile delivery
- Collaborates with Natural Resources teams in Australia and Ireland
- Collaborated with Integrated Information Core team to reuse architectures
- Collaborated with Eclipse team in India on RTC setup/usage
- Collaborated with India Software Labs Tech-support team for VM setup
- Led IP mining sessions: 3 patent disclosures, 5 internal conference abstracts, 2 internship ideas
- Trained external resources; delivered sessions on IIC
- Co-authored poster on Condition Monitoring for Regional Technical Exchange 2011

Lotus Expeditor Webcontainer Development/Test (December 2010 – March 2011)
Role: Worldwide lead
Key contributions:
- Led team as worldwide lead; complete product ownership
- Solved 2 critical Sev 1 customer issues; brought defect count to virtual zero
- Lead developer for Lotus Expeditor Toolkit; Scrum Master for several iterations
- Led Webcontainer feature discussion with Lotus Domino Server team
- Responsible for promoting adoption into Lotus Domino Server and XPages
- Trained L3 resource; conducted training sessions on LotusLive and Lotus Connections

Lotus Expeditor Toolkit and Runtime development (October 2008 – December 2010)
Roles: Lead developer for Lotus Expeditor Toolkit; Developer for Lotus Expeditor Webcontainer
Key contributions:
- Requirement analysis, planning, sizing, execution; implemented new features; fixed SPRs
- Wrote JUnit tests; Accessibility Verification Testing for Toolkit
- Successful delivery of v6.2.1 and v6.2.2 Toolkit
- Co-authored 3 DeveloperWorks articles: Introducing IBM LotusLive, LotusLive Engage, IBM Smart Cloud Meetings

JAXWS Layer for LWI 8.1.x (July 2007 – September 2008)
Role: Developer
Key contributions: Enabled JAX-WS features on LWI; wrote JUnit tests; LWI–WAS interoperability; wrote programming guide; handled FVT defects.

=== GIVEBACKS ===
Publications:
- Patent published at USPTO: determining and conveying availability (filed 10 Dec 2010)
- Patent pending: Method for KPI Confidence Determination and Optimization
- Disclosure: Gesture based human identification protocol published in IP.COM on 29 Oct 2012
- Introducing IBM LotusLive, DeveloperWorks Article, 2009
- Introducing IBM LotusLive Engage, DeveloperWorks Article, 2009
- Introducing IBM SmartCloud Meetings, DeveloperWorks Article, 2009
- Visual Component Dependency Management, National Conference CCT-2010, 2010

Conferences/talks: Regional Technical Leadership Exchange 2010; Regional Technical Exchange poster 2011 and 2012; IBM University Relations IDE talk; Quality Software Engineering 2009 poster; Design Patterns talk NHCE Nov 2011; J2EE workshops at Sir MVIT Feb 2012 and GMIT March 2012; Web 2.0 seminar CMR-IMS June 2012; IDE webinar via IBM University Relations Oct 2012.

Events organized: Hackday 6 (2008), Hackday 7 (2009), Lotus Knows 2009, IBM AoT AGM 2009, India RTLE 2010, Hackday 8 (2010), India RTE 2011, Hackday 9 (2011), Hackday 10, IBM University Relations Think-Explore-Evolve Challenge 2011.

Others: Leading internship project 'Visual Project Dependency Management' 2008; CSI member; LotusLive Meetings demo April 2011; Career Development Session AIX team Sept 2011; Scrum Master NR CoE 1H and 2H 2011; Blue Expression Toastmasters blog/newsletter; Excellence in Leadership District 82 Sri Lanka May 2012; Yoga certification SVYASA and Annamalai University.

=== AWARDS AND RECOGNITIONS ===
- IBM Eminence and Excellence Award, Sept 30 2011
- IBM Regional GMs monthly report mention, July 2011
- IBM University Relations newsletter mention, July 2011
- VP India Software Labs recognition, 22 March 2011
- IBM Inventor Award (July 2010) — 'Determining and Conveying Availability'
- Most influential Technical Experts Council Member of India, RTLE 2010
- Best Implementation award, Micro-Insurance, India Hackday 2010 Pune
- Bravo Award, October 2009
- Bravo Award 2009 (Hackday6, Hackday7, etc.)
- Bravo Award, June 2008 (internship project)
- Multiple IBM Thanks Awards
- Toastmasters Competent Communicator and Competent Leader

=== EDUCATION ===
- R. V. College of Engineering, Bangalore — B.E. Computer Science (79.2%), 2007
- Annamalai University — Post Graduate Diploma in Yoga (76%), 2010
- Annamalai University — Master of Science in Yoga (76.6%), 2011

=== TRAININGS ===
Assertive Skills, Presentation Skills, Communication Skills, Time Management Skills, Emerging Technical Leadership Lab
